brief:
Pro-Palestine demonstrators interrupted Jerry Seinfeld's performance, according to Al Jazeera English. Seinfeld responded by dancing on stage during the disruption. The incident occurred as activism related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to surface at public events.

Details about the location, timing, and size of the protest were not immediately available. The comedian's reaction drew mixed responses from the audience present at the venue.

title: Pro-Palestine protesters disrupt Jerry Seinfeld comedy show
